card.name: Words just before a place or spot
card.fires_on: Words like "a", "clear", "close" or "penetrable" that come right before a location noun such as point, spot, space or place. Seen mostly in older narrative about land, travel or battle.

modes.label: Article before a point
modes.description: The word "a" just before "point" when saying where someone went or settled.
modes.example: When we got to<< a>> point where the artillery could be used with

modes.label: Adjective before a spot
modes.description: Words like clear, close or penetrable that describe a place or spot about to be named.
modes.example: I at last found a<< clear>> space separating two ponds.

modes.label: Closeness to a place
modes.description: "Close" used to say something is near a landmark or location.
modes.example: Pettijohn erected a log cabin<< close>> to a fine spring on the north bank

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "spot" or "spots" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on a word that sets up a location, where the next word is likely "spot" or "point".
